# Native game Potential Preselection fixtures

Run standard-library tests from the repository root:

```powershell
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_ingame_preset.py -v
```

The user export and two shipped game presets are literal external inputs, not
codes generated by sspp's implementation. Expected slots were decoded by the
actual pinned SSToy TypeScript codec and then re-encoded byte for byte under Node
type stripping. Two agents additionally decoded the user export independently
using different bit readers and agreed on every potential target.

Primary sources:

- Game data commit `225c0b76027f7345a712a2d62dbe7ee22de2f836`:
  [CharPotential array order](https://github.com/Hiro420/StellaSoraData/blob/225c0b76027f7345a712a2d62dbe7ee22de2f836/KR/bin/CharPotential.json),
  [shipped PotentialPreset codes 10301/10302](https://github.com/Hiro420/StellaSoraData/blob/225c0b76027f7345a712a2d62dbe7ee22de2f836/KR/bin/PotentialPreset.json),
  [Config: PotentialPreselectionMaxLevel = 6](https://github.com/Hiro420/StellaSoraData/blob/225c0b76027f7345a712a2d62dbe7ee22de2f836/KR/bin/Config.json).
- [Independent implementation, SSToy commit 34f57606015277cf9da76a2c7cc14fa1b68ccbbf](https://github.com/JforPlay/sstoy/blob/34f57606015277cf9da76a2c7cc14fa1b68ccbbf/src/modules/app-ingame-codec.ts).
- [Game Lua dump, commit debc2b4a6b1212d4346c867eaafdb33eb889cbb8](https://github.com/jarari/StellaSoraData/blob/debc2b4a6b1212d4346c867eaafdb33eb889cbb8/lua/GameCore/Data/DataClass/PlayerPotentialPreselectionData.lua).
  This dump explicitly contains decompiler control-flow errors; it corroborates
  IDs, widths, array references, and the maximum-level configuration, and is not
  used as a runnable oracle.

The code has three big-endian uint32 IDs followed by an MSB-first body in slot
order master/assist1/assist2. Each slot reads specific flags (1 bit, targets 0/1),
normal targets (3 bits), and common targets (3 bits). Master and assist have
different ID arrays; normal ID arrays are not numerically sorted. Targets are
exact values 0..6 from Config, independent of Potential.MaxLevel or priority marks.
Trailing unused body bits must be zero. Standard Base64 with omitted padding is
accepted; invalid alphabet, noncanonical pad bits, length, and data are rejected.

`cases.json` preserves source commit/blob receipts, ordered raw CharPotential
records for the used IDs, all decoded targets including zero, and original codes.
The fixture catalog's potential values are uniform 3 as a deliberate membership
and no-clamping test; they are not claimed as individual game maximum levels.
The user code is 27 bytes with IDs [139,160,130] and no body padding. The builtin
codes both have IDs [103,108,126].

To recheck the external oracle, obtain the exact pinned TypeScript source above,
then run with Node 22.13 or newer; the script is read-only:

```powershell
node tests/fixtures/ingame_presets/verify_oracle.mjs <path-to-pinned-app-ingame-codec.ts>
```

No npm package or Python dependency is needed for these tests. This validates
code interpretation and preservation; it does not certify the overlay's screen
recognition or operate the game.
